name: Erving Goffman
shortBio: Canadian-American sociologist who developed dramaturgical analysis; analyzed social life as theatrical performances, impression management, stigma, and total institutions.
centralQuestion: How do human actors stage manage impressions, navigate social rituals, and protect face in the micro-encounters of everyday life?

keyWorks.title: The Presentation of Self in Everyday Life
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking dramaturgical analysis of social interaction as theatrical performance.

keyWorks.title: Asylums
keyWorks.description: Classic sociological analysis of total institutions and mortification of the self.

keyWorks.title: Stigma
keyWorks.description: Exploration of spoiled identity and management of social information.
